name: imageserver-self-healing-cache-integrity-99e3
instr:
imageserver cannot detect and repair damaged cached images. Add self-healing integrity without breaking legacy data or existing service and HTTP behavior.

Verified envelopes must deterministically round-trip independent Image data. Reject metadata or payload changes, truncation, and trailing bytes without exposing an image. `Image.UnmarshalBinary` must also reject trailing bytes without exposing an image. `InspectBytes(data) (Inspection, error)` distinguishes absent, legacy, verified, and corrupt values. `UnmarshalEnvelope(data) (*Envelope, error)` accepts only verified envelopes.

File, memory, Redis, and Memcache caches must verify complete stored values concurrently, never expose corruption, and atomically isolate the exact damaged value before replacement. Preserve quarantine, ownership, capacity, expiration, miss, and deletion-failure behavior. Memory must snapshot retained images, detect later pointer mutation, and account for full envelope storage.

Keep `Cache.Get` and `Cache.Set` working through `cache/memory.New`, `newTestCacheInvalidAddress`, and `newTestCacheInvalidServer`; integrity-aware code may inspect and replace values. `NewRepairCoordinator() *RepairCoordinator` must coordinate one repair per key, return independent image bytes with the same outcome to concurrent requests, and allow retry after failure. Return readable legacy values unchanged, then promote them.

Groupcache must validate envelopes from its Getter and bytes from local or remote peers. Repai
